description: Pack sizes, MOQ, order increments, overbuy cap and price breakpoints: what to actually order — Finds the cheapest valid order quantity for a requested number of units across up to 50 supplier options, for an agent buying parts or consumables sold in packs. Each option has a pack size (units per pack or notation such as "6x100", "case of 12", "12/case", "case of 6 inners"), an optional minimum order quantity, an order increment and price breakpoints; the order is rounded up to a multiple of

breakpoints.description: Price per unit from minQty units upward (the highest breakpoint reached applies).

unitPrice.description: Decimal string such as "-12.50" (up to 15 integer and 12 fraction digits). JSON numbers are not accepted: they are binary floats.

increment.description: Orders must be a multiple of this many units (default: the pack size).

innerUnits.description: Units per inner pack, for notations that count inner packs.

unitsPerPack.description: Settles an ambiguous packNotation; a value that matches no reading of the notation fails.

overbuyCapPercent.description: Reject orders exceeding the request by more than this percent.

name: pack-size
